recent.text: Caruso missed a floater down 1. OKC missed so many good looks in the paint late.
recent.author: Daily Thunder
recent.quoted_text: Thunder had chances to pull within 1 with a couple of open 3s. Miss both and now the Wolves have a chance to go up 6 with 17.3 left

recent.text: Unsuccessful challenge. Foul on Hartenstein. That one is shocking. No idea what an offensive foul on a screen is I guess. That's a play you see 50 times a game with no call.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Wolves win the challenge. Foul on Hartenstein. Wolves ball. Thunder down 104-105. 2:29 to go
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Much like the Pacers game, this is really close down the stretch. Thunder keep scoring. But can't get stops. Kenrich Williams and Ajay Mitchell checking in for McCain and Stirtz now. Will help with the defense.

recent.text: Jaylin Williams and his family provided Thanksgiving meals to 200 client families of Restore OKC at The Market at Eastpoint today. Each family received a turkey or ham, sides and dessert. This is the 4th year that JWill and his family have hosted a Thanksgiving meal giveaway https://t.co/AOvnGHneck
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Bummed for Aday Mara dealing with the shin contusion. He’s been excellent in an unexpectedly much bigger role. Real impact on both sides of the court. OKC has missed him the last couple of games. First Team All Rookie is possible, he’s been that good. Hope he’s back soon.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Obviously the long term injuries are OKC's biggest issue. But compounding those injuries with also missing Alex Caruso, Aday Mara and JWill right now (and Ajay for a couple games/SGA last night) makes every game tough. Especially on the road. 6-1 at home 4-7 away
